question: Which of the following books is written by Mulk Raj Anand?

options.text: The Private Life of an Indian Prince

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Private Life of an Indian Prince.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Confidential Existence of an Indian Ruler is a novel by** Mulk Raj Anand **previously distributed in **1953.**
 
• The book is named perhaps of Anand's most great and significant works.
 
• **In 2004,** a memorial release including this book was sent off by Indian State leader **Manmohan Singh.**
 
• Mulk Raj Anand was an Indian essayist in English, perceived for his portrayal of the existence of the less fortunate stations in conventional Indian culture.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The White Tiger** is a 2021 show movie composed and coordinated by Ramin Bahrani.
 
• **Sea of Poppies** (2008) is an original by Indian writer Amitav Ghosh which was shortlisted for the Man Booker Prize in** 2008.**
 
• **Train to Pakistan **is a verifiable novel by essayist Khushwant Singh, distributed in **1956.**
 
• **Mulk Raj Anand's **first novel, Untouchable, published in **1935,** is a chilling exposé of the lives of India's untouchable caste which were neglected at that time.
